items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Leadbelly said that all blacks are born with the blues... [INTERVIEWEE] Who said that?

ctx.x: "The blues can nudge a steel hearted man to his knees. Blues -- just a black folk disease.
What you've just heard is a poem on the blues that J.C. wrote, and included in an anthology of poetry that he put together when he was 71 years old.
Leadbelly said that all blacks are born with the blues, but now everybody has the blues.
